runtime_review.detail: Constructor mints1e27 raw units (1b at18decimals),10% Sleeve and90% distributor, creates/resolves USDG pair and approves router for own levy inventory. This is durable issuance mechanics, not retained live balances.

Transfers FROM immutable distributor or FROM token itself bypass tax and early update path. Other transfers: if neither endpoint isPool, ordinary transfer; otherwise floor(amount*200/10000) burned and floor(amount*300/10000) credited to token levy balance, recipient gets remainder. No extra fee just because both endpoints pools. Sender/receiver zero rejected; allowance infinite sentinel supported.

setPool(address,bool)0x20bec12c requires fixed Safe,nonzero target and cannot toggle canonical pair; other pools can be flagged/unflagged immediately. No arbitrary user exemption setter identified; distributor/token-sender exceptions are hardcoded.

Explicit conversion requires nonzero levy amount<=own balance and<=swapThreshold, adequate canonical USDG reserve,live stored TWAP quote and user minimum at least quoted slippage floor; router sends USDG to fixed Sleeve. Automatic conversion only on non-pool-origin transfer,not already inSwap,levy balance>threshold; caps chunk to threshold, skips low reserve/unavailable quote and catches router failure. Stored cumulative TWAP update min1800s; slippage300bps; threshold250000e18; minUSDGreserve1e9 raw($1000). These caps do not guarantee liquidity or absence of manipulation.
